video_title: Hornets vs Bulls: Brandon Miller Postgame Media Availability | 11/25/2026

quotes.speaker: Brandon Miller
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Miller on team growth despite recent narrow losses
quotes.excerpt: as we look back at these games, we see everybody getting better
quotes.quote: Obviously it's a personnel thing, but I think as we look back at these games, we see everybody getting better, whether we're losing or winning. All I ask is for everybody to play 110% hard as they can every night. I feel like we've been pretty consistent with that. So, as long as we're getting better every night, it's going to give us the best chance to win a basketball game.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Miller says the Hornets are focused on consistency and growth despite recent losses, noting that as long as the team plays as hard as they can every night, they will give themselves the best chance to win.

structured.context: Brandon Miller discusses the team's growth and effort levels during a postgame media availability.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Miller
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Miller on defensive execution and finishing close games
quotes.excerpt: I feel like we still have to finish plays as they come down to those last stretches
quotes.quote: I think we did a great job on the defensive side of the ball. I feel like we still have to finish plays as they come down to those last stretches. I gave up an offensive board, so I think just the little things like that matter. I don't think it's about shooting numbers or how many shots we made tonight. I think going into the games as shooters, I think we're going to continue to take the shots that we like. We're getting great looks, they're just not falling and I think that's part of the game.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Miller on the Hornets defensive effort against the Bulls: I think we did a great job on the defensive side of the ball, but we still have to finish plays as they come down to those last stretches.

structured.context: Brandon Miller reflects on the team's defensive performance and shooting struggles following a game.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Miller
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Miller on Christian Anderson's growth and confidence
quotes.excerpt: I think we're seeing him take more shots around the three-point line, which we love for him
quotes.quote: Just the confidence level. I think we're seeing him take more shots around the three-point line, which we love for him. He's been more aggressive in transition, creating the action, getting everybody into the right spots. I always tell him, just be a sponge. Learn as much as you can your first year. I think his second and third year, he will eventually understand and get the game of this NBA basketball in this league.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Miller is seeing major growth in Christian Anderson, specifically noting his increased confidence and aggressiveness in transition: I always tell him, just be a sponge. Learn as much as you can your first year.

structured.context: Brandon Miller praises the confidence and development of his teammate Christian Anderson.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Miller
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Miller on sticking to the process and avoiding slumps
quotes.excerpt: I think we just stick to the process. I feel like we don't have to force anything
quotes.quote: I think we just stick to the process. I feel like we don't have to force anything. I think just being confident shooters, putting that confidence in our younger guys and in all the guys really, just to take tough shots or take open shots. I think the shots that we get now are better than the past games. We've been turning it over a lot. I think getting more opportunities to let Musa get on the offensive glass a little bit more, give us that extra possession. I think our execution is great. Our shot draft is good. We don't take that many bad shots, so I think just stick to the process. As you said, it's a long season, shots are going to fall.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Miller on the Hornets shooting struggles: We don't take that many bad shots, so I think just stick to the process. It is a long season, shots are going to fall.

structured.context: Brandon Miller explains the team's offensive process and the importance of rebounding and shot selection.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Miller
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Miller on his role as a two-way player
quotes.excerpt: my teammates need me to be the guy on both ends of the floor
quotes.quote: My teammates need me to be the guy on both ends of the floor, and I'm going to do my best to be that two-way guy for my teammates just to put them in the best position to win a basketball game.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Miller on his development: My teammates need me to be the guy on both ends of the floor, and I am going to do my best to be that two-way guy for my teammates just to put them in the best position to win.

structured.context: Brandon Miller describes his commitment to being a two-way player to help his teammates win.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Miller
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Miller on team support and chemistry
quotes.excerpt: we're all here to support each other, make each other better, better men off the court
quotes.quote: I think we just lean on each other. I think we're all here to support each other, make each other better, better men off the court, and I think that's really it for that one.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Miller on the culture in the Hornets locker room: I think we just lean on each other. We are all here to support each other, make each other better, better men off the court, and I think that is really it.

structured.context: Brandon Miller discusses the importance of team chemistry and mutual support.
